summary: Kanzhun Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching a Next Day Disclosure Return under Hong Kong listing rules, reporting multiple share repurchases for cancellation between March 20 and April 15, 2026. The repurchases total approximately 12.2 million Class A ordinary shares at prices ranging from $6.57 to $7.14 per share. No board recommendation or advisor is named as this is a routine disclosure of share buyback activity. The repurchases reduce outstanding share count and return capital to shareholders; watch for continued buyback pace and potential cancellation effects.
